title: Gotrade Daily: AI Stocks Slip as Yields & Oil Climb
summary: Wall Street fell ahead of the Fed decision as AI and chip stocks slid while bond yields and oil climbed. The watchlist for tonight's US session.
body_markdown:
According to Yahoo Finance, the main trigger for the tech pullback was a call by several AI lab leaders to slow the pace of AI development. The concern dragged chip stocks lower across global markets. Not everything traded red, though. A US$60 billion AI-chip deal between Amazon and Qualcomm lifted the chip bet by nearly 9%.


## Tonight's Watchlist


Stock Movement What to Watch


[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) Pressured with chip stocks Monday (14/09) Center of the AI selloff; the strongest read-through into the Fed decision


[AMZN](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amzn/) Lifted by a US$60B AI-chip deal The deal with Qualcomm lifted the chip sector nearly 9%


[QCOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/qcom/) Also firmer as Amazon's deal partner A gauge of AI-chip demand beyond Nvidia


[XOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/xom/) Boosted by oil at a four-month high (WTI ~US$102) Energy as relative support while the market weakens


[META](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/meta/) Price target raised to US$650 at Wedbush A bullish catalyst amid the AI selloff


## Tonight's Catalysts


### The AI and chip selloff leads Wall Street lower


Artificial intelligence and semiconductor stocks were the main drag on Monday (14/09). According to Yahoo Finance, several AI lab leaders called to slow AI development, raising concern over the sector's valuations. **Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** sits at the center of attention as the barometer of AI spending. For investors, the question is whether this is a healthy correction or the start of a deeper shift in sentiment.


### Amazon and Qualcomm's US$60B AI deal is the bright spot


**Amazon ([AMZN](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amzn/) )** and **Qualcomm ([QCOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/qcom/) )** told a different story within the weakness. Their US$60 billion AI-chip deal lifted the chip bet by nearly 9%. The deal signals that AI-compute demand remains strong, and it widens the map of AI-chip players beyond Nvidia.
